bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to health; direction to commissioner of health to join World Health Organization Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+DIRECTION TO COMMISSIONER OF HEALTH; JOIN WORLD HEALTH ORGANIZATION GLOBAL OUTBREAK ALERT AND RESPONSE NETWORK. +]

[+By September 1, 2026, the commissioner of health must identify the process required for the Minnesota Department of Health to apply to join the World Health Organization Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network (GOARN). By December 1, 2026, the commissioner must take steps necessary for the Minnesota Department of Health to apply to join GOARN. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health; direction to commissioner of health to join World Health Organization Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. DIRECTION TO COMMISSIONER OF HEALTH; JOIN WORLD HEALTH ORGANIZATION GLOBAL OUTBREAK ALERT AND RESPONSE NETWORK.

By September 1, 2026, the commissioner of health must identify the process required for the Minnesota Department of Health to apply to join the World Health Organization Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network (GOARN). By December 1, 2026, the commissioner must take steps necessary for the Minnesota Department of Health to apply to join GOARN.
additions: DIRECTION TO COMMISSIONER OF HEALTH; JOIN WORLD HEALTH ORGANIZATION GLOBAL OUTBREAK ALERT AND RESPONSE NETWORK.

By September 1, 2026, the commissioner of health must identify the process required for the Minnesota Department of Health to apply to join the World Health Organization Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network (GOARN). By December 1, 2026, the commissioner must take steps necessary for the Minnesota Department of Health to apply to join GOARN.
